evals.prompt: write a rego policy blocking public s3 buckets
evals.expected_output: Writes a narrowly-scoped, single-rule policy (e.g. deny-public-s3-acl) evaluated against the Terraform plan output before apply, includes both a passing and failing test fixture, and starts it in audit/log-only mode rather than immediately enforcing.

evals.prompt: our policy check keeps warning but nothing ever actually gets blocked
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that a policy left permanently in warn-only mode has the same effect as no policy, and recommends reviewing the audit-period findings, communicating a promotion date, and flipping it to a pipeline-failing enforcing check once the false-positive rate is near zero.

evals.prompt: let's turn this new policy on as a hard block right away, no audit period needed
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: a brand-new policy enforced immediately will almost certainly break a legitimate change nobody anticipated; ship it in audit/log-only mode first, review what it flags against real traffic, and only promote to enforcing once false positives are near zero.
